'''Radomir Saičić''' ({{langx|sr|Радомир Саичић}}; born 31 October 1961) is a Serbian [[chemist]], university professor and politician. A professor of [[organic chemistry]] and faculty of the department of Chemistry of the [[University of Belgrade]], he has been a full member of the [[Serbian Academy of Sciences and Arts]] (SANU) since 2018.<ref name="SANU-en">{{Cite web |title=Radomir N. Saičić |url=https://www.sanu.ac.rs/en/member/saicic-n-radomir/ |access-date=26 October 2026 |website=[[Serbian Academy of Sciences and Arts]]}}</ref><ref name="FCUB">{{Cite web |title=FCUB – Radomir N. Saičić, Ph.D. |url=https://chem.bg.ac.rs/osoblje/13-en.html |access-date=26 October 2026 |publisher=University of Belgrade Faculty of Chemistry}}</ref> A supporter of the [[2024–present Serbian anti-corruption protests|student-led anti-corruption protests]], he was one of the founders of the citizens' group through which the [[Student List]] ran as a political party in the [[2026 Serbian parliamentary election]], and a candidate for Student List. On election night, he announced Student List's victory from its headquarters.<ref name="Telegraf-bio" /><ref name="RTS-night" />

== Early life and education ==
Saičić was born on 31 October 1961 in [[Belgrade]].<ref name="Telegraf-bio">{{Cite news |last=Jovanović |first=Silvija |date=26 October 2026 |title=Ko je Radomir Saičić koji je sinoć proglasio pobedu studenata |trans-title=Who is Radomir Saičić, who announced the students' victory last night |url=https://politika.telegraf.rs/izbori-2026/4421241-ko-je-radomir-saicic-koji-je-sinoc-proglasio-pobedu-studenata |access-date=26 October 2026 |work=[[Telegraf.rs|Telegraf]] |language=sr}}</ref> His father, Nikola Saičić, was an architect and university professor,<ref name="Telegraf-bio" /> and his parents are [[Montenegrin Serbs]].<ref name="Danas-bio">{{Cite news |date=22 October 2026 |title=Trn u oku naprednjacima u tabloidima: Ko je profesor i akademik Radomir Saičić? |trans-title=A thorn in the side of the Progressives in the tabloids: Who is professor and academician Radomir Saičić? |url=https://www.danas.rs/vesti/drustvo/akademik-radomir-saicic-biografija/ |access-date=22 October 2026 |work=[[Danas (newspaper)|Danas]] |language=sr}}</ref> He attended the [[Mathematical Grammar School]] in Belgrade.<ref name="Telegraf-bio" />

He studied chemistry at the Faculty of Natural Sciences and Mathematics of the University of Belgrade (now the Faculty of Chemistry), graduating in 1983, and obtained his master's degree there in 1987.<ref name="SANU-en" /> He defended his doctoral dissertation on free-radical chemistry, under the supervision of Živorad Čeković, in 1991.{{efn|SANU gives 1992 as the year of his doctorate.<ref name="SANU-en" />}}<ref name="Telegraf-bio" /><ref name="Istinomer">{{Cite web |title=Radomir Saičić |url=https://www.istinomer.rs/akter/radomir-saicic/ |access-date=22 October 2026 |website=Istinomer |language=sr}}</ref> From 1995 to 1996, he completed postdoctoral studies at the Institute for the Chemistry of Natural Products of the [[French National Centre for Scientific Research]] in [[Gif-sur-Yvette]].<ref name="SANU-en" /> He served in the [[Yugoslav Wars]].<ref name="Danas-bio" />

== Academic career ==
After graduating, Saičić became a trainee teaching assistant at the Faculty of Natural Sciences and Mathematics, and was appointed teaching assistant in 1989.<ref name="Istinomer" /> He was an associate professor at the Faculty of Chemistry from 1997 to 2002, when he became a full professor.<ref name="Telegraf-bio" /><ref name="FCUB" /> He headed the Department of Organic Chemistry from 1999 to 2003 and again from 2023, and chairs the faculty's ethics commission.<ref name="FCUB" /><ref name="Telegraf-bio" /> His research focuses on [[organic synthesis]] and [[medicinal chemistry]], particularly the [[total synthesis]] of [[natural product]]s such as [[paclitaxel]] (taxol) and its derivatives, which are used in [[chemotherapy]].<ref name="FCUB" /><ref name="RTS-2020">{{Cite web |title=Хоћу да знам: Лекови који се користе против вируса корона |trans-title=I want to know: Drugs used against the coronavirus |url=https://www.rts.rs/radio/radio-beograd-2/4112118/lekovi-koji-se-koriste-protiv-virusa-korona.html |access-date=22 October 2026 |website=[[Radio Television of Serbia|RTS]] |language=sr}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=18 April 2013 |title=Посета делегације Старог града Хемијском факултету |trans-title=Visit of the Stari Grad delegation to the Faculty of Chemistry |url=https://www.starigrad.org.rs/poseta-delegacije-starog-grada-hemijskom-fakultetu/ |access-date=22 October 2026 |website=Stari Grad |language=sr}}</ref>

In 2020, he became principal investigator of a project funded by the Science Fund of the Republic of Serbia under its special [[COVID-19]] programme, on the repurposing of iminosugars and [[chloroquine]] analogues as therapies against [[RNA virus]]es. The project involved the Faculty of Chemistry, the Institute of Chemistry, Technology and Metallurgy and the Innovation Centre of the Faculty of Chemistry, in collaboration with the [[Pasteur Institute]] in Paris.<ref name="RTS-2020" /><ref name="FCUB" />

Saičić was elected a corresponding member of SANU, in its Department of Chemical and Biological Sciences, on 1 November 2012, and a full member on 8 November 2018.<ref name="SANU-en" /> He has been a member of the Serbian Chemical Society since 1984.<ref name="Telegraf-bio" />

== Political activity ==
Saičić supported the [[2024–2026 Serbian anti-corruption protests|student-led anti-corruption protests]] that followed the [[Novi Sad railway station canopy collapse]] in November 2024, and was targeted by pro-government media for doing so.<ref name="Danas-bio" /> In June 2025, he was one of 25 SANU members who signed a petition calling for the resignation of [[Aleksandar Vučić]] over the "collapse of the democratic, institutional and social foundations of our country".<ref>{{Cite web |last=Jakonić |first=Tamara |date=13 June 2025 |title=Peticiju kojom se zahteva ostavka Aleksandra Vučića potpisalo 25 članova SANU |trans-title=Petition demanding the resignation of Aleksandar Vučić signed by 25 members of SANU |url=https://autonomija.info/peticiju-kojom-se-zahteva-ostavka-aleksandra-vucica-potpisalo-25-clanova-sanu/ |access-date=22 October 2026 |website=Autonomija |language=sr}}</ref> In May 2026, he walked out of the opening of an exhibition of the [[Serbian Orthodox Church]] in the SANU Gallery when Minister of Culture [[Nikola Selaković]] was announced as a speaker, saying that Selaković had caused "immeasurable damage to Serbian culture".<ref>{{Cite news |date=14 May 2026 |title=Akademik demonstrativno napustio otvaranje izložbe SPC u Galeriji SANU zbog Selakovića |trans-title=Academician walks out of the opening of the SPC exhibition in the SANU Gallery because of Selaković |url=https://n1info.rs/vesti/akademik-demonstrativno-napustio-otvaranje-izlozbe-spc-u-galeriji-sanu-zbog-selakovica/ |access-date=26 October 2026 |work=[[N1 (TV channel)|N1]] |language=sr}}</ref> Speaking at a protest at [[Slavija Square]] later that month, he accused the government of beating "children who seek justice" while protecting criminals.<ref>{{Cite news |date=23 May 2026 |title=Akademik Saičić: Batinaju decu koja traže pravdu, a štite kriminalce koji aktivno pomažu ubicama |trans-title=Academician Saičić: They beat children who seek justice and protect criminals who actively help murderers |url=https://n1info.rs/vesti/akademik-saicic-batinaju-decu-koja-traze-pravdu-a-stite-kriminalce-koji-aktivno-pomazu-ubicama/ |access-date=26 October 2026 |work=[[N1 (TV channel)|N1]] |language=sr}}</ref>

=== 2026 parliamentary election ===
Saičić was one of 14 founders of the citizens' group "Student List – Students Are Winning", through which the [[Student List]] ran in the [[2026 Serbian parliamentary election|2026 snap parliamentary election]], and a candidate of the party. Confirming his candidacy on 10 September 2026, he described the government as "criminalised and corrupt" and said he was prepared to put "even his life" at the disposal of the students and the country.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Radovanović |first=Sanja |date=10 September 2026 |title=Akademik Saičić potvrdio da se nalazi na Studentskoj listi: „Spreman sam i život da stavim na raspolaganje studentima i državi Srbiji" |trans-title=Academician Saičić confirmed he is on the Student List: "I am ready to put even my life at the disposal of the students and the state of Serbia" |url=https://nova.rs/vesti/drustvo/akademik-saicic-potvrdio-da-se-nalazi-na-studentskoj-listi/ |access-date=26 October 2026 |work=[[NOVA portal]] |language=sr}}</ref> He spoke at the rally in [[Novi Sad]] that opened Student List's campaign the same day, where the first candidates were presented, saying that Serbia was "occupied today too, not by a foreign invader, but from within".<ref>{{Cite news |date=10 September 2026 |title=Profesor Saičić: Studenti izabrali najbolje ljude da preuzmu kormilo ovoga broda koji tone i privedu ga u mirnu luku |trans-title=Professor Saičić: The students chose the best people to take the helm of this sinking ship and bring it to a safe harbour |url=https://n1info.rs/vesti/radomir-saicic-studentska-lista-novi-sad-skup/ |access-date=26 October 2026 |work=[[N1 (TV channel)|N1]] |language=sr}}</ref><ref name="MasinaKandidati">{{cite web |date=10 September 2026 |title=Otkriven deo kandidata sa Studentske liste |trans-title=Some of the Student List candidates revealed |url=https://www.masina.rs/otkriven-deo-kandidata-sa-studentske-liste/ |access-date=23 September 2026 |website=Mašina |language=sr}}</ref><ref name="VremeKandidati">{{cite web |date=10 September 2026 |title=Predstavljeni prvi kandidati Studentske liste |trans-title=First Student List candidates presented |url=https://vreme.com/vesti/studenti-predizborna-kampanja-studentska-lista/ |access-date=23 September 2026 |website=[[Vreme]] |language=sr}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=26 October 2026 |title=Ko su kandidati Studentske liste koji mogu da računaju na poslanički mandat? |trans-title=Which Student List candidates can count on a parliamentary mandate? |url=https://021.rs/info/srbija/459284/ko-su-kandidati-studentske-liste-koji-mogu-da-racunaju-na-poslanicki-mandat |access-date=26 October 2026 |work=021.rs |language=sr}}</ref> 

On the parliamentary election night, after Vučić conceded defeat, Saičić, described by ''[[Bloomberg News|Bloomberg]]'' as one of the Student List's leaders,<ref>{{cite news |date=25 October 2026 |title=Serbia's Vucic Concedes Defeat in Snap Election After Putin-Like Gamble |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-25/serbian-long-time-leader-vucic-concedes-defeat-in-snap-vote |access-date=26 October 2026 |work=[[Bloomberg News|Bloomberg]]}}</ref> addressed supporters from Student List headquarters and announced its victory. He said: "Dear Serbia, tonight the voice of the people is being heard. Tonight we celebrate victory, tomorrow we build the future."<ref>{{cite news |date=25 October 2026 |title=Vucic Concedes Electoral Defeat, Setting Stage For New Era Of Serbian Politics, Relations With West |url=https://www.rferl.org/amp/vucic-concession-serbia-parliament-elections-students/33884044.html |access-date=26 October 2026 |work=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]]}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |date=25 October 2026 |title=Obraćanje iz sedišta „Studentske liste": Pobedili smo na parlamentarnim izborima, ali to je tek početak |trans-title=Address from the Student List headquarters: We won the parliamentary elections, but this is only the beginning |url=https://pancevac-online.rs/en/467879/obracanje-iz-sedista-studentske-liste-pobedili-smo-na-parlamentarnim-izborima-ali-to-je-tek-pocetak/ |access-date=26 October 2026 |work=Pančevac |language=sr}}</ref> Calling the result "not anyone's trophy, but a victory of the citizens", he urged supporters to celebrate "without hatred", adding that "tomorrow the work begins".<ref name="RTS-night">{{Cite news |date=25 October 2026 |title=Akademik Saičić ispred Studentske liste: Hvala vam na poverenju, na hrabrosti i što ste verovali da je promena moguća |trans-title=Academician Saičić on behalf of the Student List: Thank you for your trust, your courage and for believing that change is possible |url=https://www.rts.rs/lat/vesti/izbori-2026/6069595/akademik-saicic-ispred-studentske-liste-hvala-vam-na-poverenju-na-hrabrosti-i-sto-ste-verovali-da-je-promena-moguca.html |access-date=26 October 2026 |work=[[Radio Television of Serbia|RTS]] |language=sr}}</ref>

In October 2026, ''Danas'' and ''The Economist'' mentioned him among possible candidates in the upcoming [[2026 Serbian presidential election|presidential election]].<ref>{{Cite news |date=13 October 2026 |title=I ti izbori kucaju na vrata: Ko je najbolji kandidat za predsednika ili predsednicu Srbije? |trans-title=Those elections are also knocking on the door: Who is the best candidate for president of Serbia? |url=https://www.danas.rs/vesti/politika/kandidat-za-predsednicke-izbore/ |access-date=21 October 2026 |work=[[Danas (newspaper)|Danas]] |language=sr}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=2026-10-26 |title=Aleksandar Vucic, Serbia’s autocrat, loses to a bunch of students |url=https://www.economist.com/europe/2026/10/26/aleksandar-vucic-serbias-autocrat-loses-to-a-bunch-of-students?taid=6adf871b1579270001ce0c24 |access-date=2026-10-26 |work=The Economist |language=en}}</ref>

== Political positions ==
In an interview with RTS during the campaign, Saičić said that he considered [[Kosovo]] a "temporarily occupied territory", that the Student List's starting point was the [[Constitution of Serbia]], and that Serbia should secure a good life for the Serbs there through negotiations with relevant international actors. He supported "productive relations" with Russia, citing Serbia's energy needs and historical ties, and described the future of [[Republika Srpska]] as "part of the future of the Serbian people". He said that Student List offered the [[rule of law]] and equality before the law, regardless of citizens' religious or political views.<ref name="RTS-interview">{{Cite web |date=20 October 2026 |title=Saičić: Studentska lista donosi promenu sistema vrednosti, treba nam pravna država |trans-title=Saičić: The Student List brings a change in the system of values, we need the rule of law |url=https://www.rts.rs/lat/vesti/izbori-2026/6066244/saicic-studenti-lista-izbori-2026.html |access-date=22 October 2026 |website=[[Radio Television of Serbia|RTS]] |language=sr}}</ref> Asked about his differences with sociologist and fellow candidate [[Jovo Bakić]], he said that their shared political goals mattered more than personal differences, and that they agreed on environmental protection.<ref>{{Cite news |date=21 October 2026 |title="Pobeda Studentske liste je izvesna": Akademik Saičić o promeni vlasti, Rusiji, Kosovu i odnosu sa Jovom Bakićem |trans-title="The Student List's victory is certain": Academician Saičić on the change of government, Russia, Kosovo and his relationship with Jovo Bakić |url=https://nova.rs/vesti/politika/pobeda-studentske-liste-je-izvesna-akademik-saicic-o-promeni-vlasti-rusiji-kosovu-i-odnosu-sa-jovom-bakicem/ |access-date=26 October 2026 |work=[[NOVA portal]] |language=sr}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
Saičić is religious and an [[Serbian Orthodox Church|Orthodox Christian]].<ref name="Istinomer" /> He has been married twice.<ref name="Danas-bio" />

== Awards and honours ==
* October Prize of the City of Belgrade for students, for his master's thesis (1987)<ref name="SANU-en" />
* Medal of the Serbian Chemical Society (1995)<ref name="SANU-en" />
* Award of the City of Belgrade for the best scientific achievement in 2006 (awarded in 2007)<ref name="SANU-en" />
